text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Blend contamination is the leading non-astrophysical explanation: 29 of 40 trigger points are flagged BLEND_SUSPECT, and the event's detections in the dny and dnr series carry this tag repeatedly, so a neighbouring star could be contributing to the measured magnitudes.","evidence_ids":["E-055","E-038","E-039","E-041","E-043","E-045"]},{"text":"The emulsion response is suspect: 17 of 40 points are flagged NON_BLUE, and the deepest offsets in the step come from the dny and dnr series, whose zero points are strongly negative (dnr -1.449, dny -1.123), so the step could be an emulsion colour or sensitivity effect rather than a change in the star.","evidence_ids":["E-053","E-023","E-024","E-039","E-042","E-041"]},{"text":"The step falls where the plate series change: the event runs from 1971.04 to 1971.97, the ir series (zero point -0.483) supplies the post-step points while dnr and dny supply the pre-step points, so a seam between plate series could produce the apparent step in amplitude 0.53 mag.","evidence_ids":["E-002","E-027","E-044","E-046","E-047","E-049","E-051","E-045"]},{"text":"Shape and sampling weaken the event: 4 points are flagged SHAPE_OUTLIER and the trigger shows only 30 of 40 points, with the rest omitted by rule, so the step cannot be checked against the full set of measurements.","evidence_ids":["E-057","E-052","E-045","E-046"]},{"text":"The packet does not contain enough to rule out an astrophysical origin: the summary shows the 1960 decade scatter is high (0.681) and no series-level calibration check for the ir series is given, so the artifact case is plausible but not demonstrated. Missing: per-plate comparison stars and the full 40-point trigger.","evidence_ids":["E-012","E-027","E-052","E-001"]}]}
